summary: Independent review verified that the exact candidate fully implements the original optional inbound admin-auth contract for the experimental Rust router's POST /flush_cache endpoint. The recorded base permits unauthenticated fan-out. The candidate preserves that behavior when no key is configured, adds --admin-api-key, accepts only the exact configured Bearer credential, returns 401 before worker fan-out for missing or malformed credentials, and does not forward the inbound credential to workers.

tests.what_was_measured: On the exact recorded base, an unauthenticated POST /flush_cache reached two real loopback HTTP workers and returned 200, reproducing the original insecure-by-default behavior before the optional control existed. Raw output: reports/j-5a68770c45fa/raw/base_unauthenticated_fanout.log

At exact candidate commit, all nine cache-route tests passed, including candidate regression tests for zero fan-out on unauthorized requests, exact bearer success, backward compatibility, and absence of the inbound Authorization header at the worker. Raw output: reports/j-5a68770c45fa/raw/candidate_cache_tests.log

Independent black-box execution of the freshly rebuilt router against a separate Python loopback worker: no configured key returned 200 and fanned out; missing, raw, Basic, lowercase bearer, wrong-key, and extra-suffix credentials all returned 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer and zero worker calls; the exact bearer key returned 200 with one worker call and no forwarded Authorization header. Raw output: reports/j-5a68770c45fa/raw/blackbox_auth.log
Complete candidate router suite passed: 549 library tests, 4 binary tests, 58 component tests, and 90 proxy tests. Raw output: reports/j-5a68770c45fa/raw/candidate_full_test.log

Fresh optimized native x86-64 Rust router built from the exact candidate with rustc 1.90.0. Binary path: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-5a68770c45fa/cargo-target/release/sgl-router; SHA-256 d58ea68388fae7a7d5759a6a25299da29cdccc0e8bd40904474a66d18aa8cb18. Build, file, and linkage evidence are retained under reports/j-5a68770c45fa/raw/.
Candidate Rust source passes rustfmt 1.90.0. Raw output: reports/j-5a68770c45fa/raw/candidate_fmt.log

gpu_evidence: No GPU was used. This issue is an architecture-independent Rust HTTP authorization and fan-out boundary; the relevant native executable and real loopback HTTP transport were exercised directly. GPU/model numerical output is not part of the original contract.
remaining_limitations: Validation was performed on x86-64 Linux; no alternate CPU architecture was available.
No GPU or model-serving workload was run because neither is involved in the router inbound authentication contract.
The issue explicitly starts with /flush_cache; other routes were not evaluated as newly protected admin endpoints.
